caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed object resembling a pair of antique brass candle wick trimmers or snuffers. The tool is metallic and colored in shades of gold and bronze, suggesting a brass or similar alloy material. It has two round finger holes at one end, similar to scissors, with a jointed mechanism allowing the tool to open and close. Attached to one arm is a flat, triangular guard, and next to it is a box-like compartment with a sharp tip at the opposite end, which is designed to catch trimmed wicks. The object is centrally positioned on a light beige background, with a faint rectangular outline framing the tool. There are handwritten notations in pencil, including "actual size" at the lower left and a signature at the lower right. The overall composition is simple, with the object isolated and clearly rendered against the plain background.
title: Candle Snuffer
